purpose: Freeze the complete candidate-agnostic 32-query Hong gate selected by V78. Define immutable fresh indices, artifact and provenance contracts, measurement paths, one global statistical decision, numerical invariants, single-use behavior, and authorization boundaries without choosing, constructing, sampling, or evaluating a candidate.

single_use_fresh_selection.role: one target-unseen screen for one separately frozen candidate; no tuning, retry, or alternative candidate after disclosure
single_use_fresh_selection.SIMBA_confirmation_caveat: This screen uses every untouched object in the current SIMBA validation product; passing does not create a second independent SIMBA confirmation.

required_bindings: member count, sampler, steps, batch, seeds, and pairing invariant
output paths and refusal of existing output

must_bind: V79 program hash and gate implementation commit/hash
separately approved candidate program hash and freeze commit
candidate and paired-control ensemble file paths and SHA256 per domain
candidate and paired-control evaluator metrics paths and SHA256 per domain
source indices, seeds, sampler, members, checkpoint, and innovation-pairing digests
preflight result proving no selected payload was read before candidate freeze

ensemble_contract.source_indices_exact_order: must equal the corresponding frozen V79 list
ensemble_contract.paired_innovation_requirement: candidate-specific program must define and prove the appropriate candidate/control pairing; the gate reports but never invents pairing

physical_energy_observation.q99_999: signed generated-minus-truth pooled log10rho q99.999 delta per domain
physical_energy_observation.Q4: generated-over-truth mean physical delta-squared ratio per domain
physical_energy_observation.high_k_power: generated-over-truth log-density total-power ratio in 3-6 and 6-10.0531 h/Mpc per domain
physical_energy_observation.residual_RMS: generated residual RMS over truth residual RMS per domain
physical_energy_observation.density_PDF: generated-versus-truth log10-density histogram TV per domain
physical_energy_observation.two_point: generated-versus-truth KS mean in 0-1, 1-3, and 3-10 Mpc/h per domain
physical_energy_observation.environment: Boolean that all frozen generated mean peak/void errors are strictly smaller than the corresponding deterministic mean errors per domain
physical_energy_observation.energy: candidate mean query-wise unbiased scalar maximum-energy score minus paired-control score per domain

physical_energy_global_block.implementation: exactly V78 family transforms, ridge covariance, empirical tails, sparse max(-log p), dense Fisher sum, and twice-minimum block p

rank_coverage_global_block.implementation: V76 exact complete-field truth-label randomization independently within each domain, pooled over all 32 queries
rank_coverage_global_block.tie_priority_and_relabel_seeds: derive separate deterministic 64-bit seeds from SHA256(V79 program SHA256, candidate ensemble SHA256, domain, purpose)
rank_coverage_global_block.six_p_values: rank and coverage separately for each of three domains

deterministic_numerical_pass: all ensemble, metric, and p-value quantities finite
maximum absolute generated residual cube mean <=1e-7
all shapes, hashes, source indices, provenance, and pairing invariants exact
complete_decision.candidate_pass: statistical pass and every deterministic numerical/provenance requirement pass

stage_behavior.pass: seal result and await a new explicit user decision about independent confirmation or downstream CF4 work
stage_behavior.fail: seal result and stop; no retry, seed change, metric change, candidate change, or use of another fresh subset

claim_boundary.allowed_after_pass: the frozen candidate passes this single target-unseen compatible-population screen at the named metrics and global alpha
forbidden_after_pass: claim of proof that the density field or IC is correct
claim of CF4 applicability before the observational input contract is satisfied
claim of Local Group/Virgo/Coma/void reproduction before dynamical constrained-realization tests

implementation_only_authorization.required_stop: After implementation tests and GitHub push, await explicit user approval for a separately frozen candidate design.
